mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_tool_call (tool_call_id, turn_id, session_id, exec_id, llm_call_id, node_id, tool_name, arguments, status) VALUES (#{toolCallId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{execId}, #{llmCallId}, #{nodeId}, #{toolName}, CAST(#{argumentsJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_tool_call SET result = #{result}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}
mapper.select: SELECT turn_id, tool_name, arguments::text AS arguments, result FROM flow_tool_call WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND tool_name <> 'ask_user' AND turn_id IN #{tid} ORDER BY started_at

SELECT tool_call_id, exec_id, llm_call_id, node_id, tool_name, arguments::text AS arguments, result, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_tool_call WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY started_at
